name: JKDM · HS Explorer (the applied tariff)
why_not_automatic: manual by decision, CONVENTIONS rule 14: tariff schedules and de minimis thresholds are not legislation, differ in shape in every economy, and answer four indicators — a researcher reads the figure and records it with the page and the date; **and the tariff is search-only** — pick a tariff type and an HS code. breadth_basis: measured: the tariff-type list names the order in force

name: MyLVG · de minimis and low-value goods
why_not_automatic: manual by decision, CONVENTIONS rule 14: tariff schedules and de minimis thresholds are not legislation, differ in shape in every economy, and answer four indicators — a researcher reads the figure and records it with the page and the date
